description: Where Jesus speaks, for the reader's red letters, keyed by record: "all" (the sentence continues his words from its start), "quoted" (its quotations are his words), a list of the quotations that are (counted from 0), or {"inner": "quoted"} (or "all") where someone else quotes his words (Acts 22:7). The words are found in each rendering from its own quotation marks; see owb/words_of_jesus.py. An AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.
